subject: OOOOooooohhh  Doggy!
author: oO EezO Oo
body:
I can't explain how happy I am how the whole thing actually worked out.  I really do want to do another one soon.  The first one I wanted to run kind of small to work out the format, and just see if I could actually put one together.  I didn't want it to get out of hand with too many entrants and become un-manageable.  But now that I think I know what I'm doing (yeah right, just make it up as you go lol) I feel comfortable with getting the word out more for the next one.  I was hoping / wondering if after you (Zombie) saw how the last one worked out, if I could plug the next Pro/Am tourney on BurnoutAholics?  I honestly didn't know if the first one would work so I didn't want to tie BurnoutAholics.com into it too much.   And Ichi, I couldn't have done it without you man, I really appreciate all the help.

 

CAPS LOCK - Cruise control for AWESOME!!

subject: The More You Try To Avoid Someone.... Takedowns Are Inevitable!!
author: ichienkai
body:
I did apologise to you Zombie over in the Adopt A Scrub thread!  Of course the takedowns were not intentional - It was a good night, better if we had won and got in the final room but hey ho thats how it goes!  There will be another Tourney night soon (Think Eezo is gonna take a short break from it) but when it does arise we'll make sure the Burnoutaholics here are better informed of it so the Revenge fans can join if they wish to - it will be bigger this time but i agree having four in each room is much more managable for the hosts.... I even met Sonic STX that night too, a cool guy: its ace to finally meet or race with members of this site.

 

--Bootleg is a window lickin' stalker--
